verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://motherduck.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a MotherDuck overview. The docs also publish an llms-full.txt and serve many pages as raw markdown (.md URLs such as sharing-data.md and mcp.md), so an agent can be pointed straight at agent-friendly docs. missing for 10: independent/community corroboration of agents using these docs, and consistent markdown variants (the getting-started/.md probe returned 404).
